title: Chapter 262 Nanshan Society Headquarters
content:
Chapter 262 Nanshan Society Headquarters

[System announcement: Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Village, led the Nanshan Society to break through Nanshanji and became the first player to break through the system town. This is hereby announced. ]

Whenever there is a major event, there must be a system announcement.

Wang Shuo was not surprised.

What he cares about is what the reward is this time!

[Since you are the first player to break through the system town, you will be rewarded with +10 commander value, +2000 reputation, +5 intermediate general job transfer certificate, +1 priest job transfer certificate, and +1 special building teleportation array. ]

[Wana Village Territory Reputation +500]

Seeing these rewards, Wang Shuo finally smiled.

Just when Wang Shuo broke through the core of the territory, Gong Zheng had already led people to the treasury in the city lord's mansion.

They searched the supplies inside.

The supplies inside are very rich, including various mineral resources, martial arts skills, weapons and armor, etc.

However, these things are no longer very attractive to Wang Shuo.

The most important gain of this trip is the heart of the town.

After everyone had looted enough spoils, Wang Shuo summoned all the lords of Nanshanhui to the lord's mansion to discuss matters.

The current issue is how to distribute the territory of Nanshanji.

Wang Shuo did not raise this issue in the previous meeting, but just now, someone told Wang Shuo about it.

Wang Shuo thought about it and asked everyone's opinions.

After all, it is much more prosperous than the villages of the lords.

Some people suggested that one person should have several shops.

Some people also suggested that it should be managed in a unified manner.

Finally, after a show of hands, Nanshanji belonged to Nanshanhui and became the headquarters of Nanshanhui. The profits obtained were distributed to all the lords.

Wang Shuo had no objection to this.

These people had never considered that half a month later, when the undead revived, who would guard this place?

If they couldn't guard it, nothing would be left.

Perhaps some people thought of this, but they were still reluctant to abandon a town that was more prosperous than their own territory.

Wang Shuo then left the lord's mansion and came to Fuyue Inn.

Chef Zhang was sitting in the hall with a helpless look on his face.

When he saw Wang Shuo coming in, he didn't even look at him.

He was angry at this moment. The initiator of all this was Wang Shuo. His restaurant was thriving and developing rapidly.

But all this was messed up by Wang Shuo.

Although he knew that this kind of thing would happen sooner or later, if not Wang Shuo, it could also be Li Shuo...

But he was angry.

"Brother Chef, you know, I can't do anything about it." Wang Shuo walked to the side of the table and smiled awkwardly at Chef Zhang.

"Lord Wang, you are so powerful now!" Chef Zhang was still a little upset.

"Brother Chef, born in a turbulent time, it's either you or I. If we hadn't met, would you still be able to sit here safely now?" Wang Shuo was sincere and sincere. Although it was the truth, it was unpleasant to hear.

After a while, Chef Zhang sighed dejectedly.

"It's all this..." Chef Zhang held back the words when they came to his lips.

Seeing that Chef Zhang had calmed down.

Wang Shuo then said: "Brother Chef, there is not much time left for the invasion of the Undead Legion. Do you have any plans? If not, my territory can still accommodate a restaurant for you."

The reason why Wang Shuo came to see Chef Zhang in person was because he regarded Chef Zhang as a friend.

Chef Zhang himself had no ambitions. What he wanted to do most was to open a restaurant.

This did not conflict with Wang Shuo's goal.

In this survival game, there are very few people who can become friends. Wang Shuo still cherishes this kind of emotion.

"I am a chef, what else can I do? I can only rely on you! Haha..." Chef Zhang said, and smiled at Wang Shuo.

"Haha, let's go and take a look at my territory."
